assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing turned DNA reading into a scalable chemical-physical measurement (reversible terminators, clonal amplification, single-molecule and pyrosequencing readout) and transformed genomics and medicine; a clear, generative and explainable capability.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman originated the Solexa sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry; Rothberg's pyrosequencing-based 454 platform was the first commercial massively parallel system. Pascal Mayer's early contribution and the weight between the two technology lines are unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Two decades of global use and multiple generations of instruments make the impact beyond doubt; recognition is timely and not premature.
uncertainties: Whether the prize should be framed as chemistry rather than biology/technology
Fair split between Solexa and 454 lineages and Mayer's role
Sanger sequencing was recognised in 1980, so the committee must articulate what is new

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers produced a photovoltaic efficiency rise from about 4 percent to over 25 percent in little more than a decade, with a physically rich story of defect tolerance, long carrier diffusion lengths and approach to the Shockley-Queisser limit; high generative potential in materials chemistry.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first used perovskites as sensitizers (2009); Park and Snaith made the solid-state devices that triggered the field in 2012. Gratzel, Kanatzidis and Seok also have strong claims, so any three-person configuration leaves out major contributors.
assessment.maturity: Very strongly confirmed and independently reproduced, but long-term stability and commercial deployment are still unproven, so some may consider recognition slightly early.
uncertainties: Operational stability and lead toxicity may limit practical maturity
Crowded credit among six names; three-person limit is contentious
Efficiency records are partly engineering rather than a single chemical discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Electrical reading of single polymers through nanopores is a physicist's dream realised: single-molecule transport measurement that yields sequence and chemistry readout, now a commercial long-read sequencing platform with real-time, portable use.
assessment.attribution: Deamer and Branton conceived the nanopore sequencing concept, Kasianowicz demonstrated single-stranded DNA translocation through alpha-hemolysin, Bayley engineered protein pores, and Akeson showed enzyme-controlled ratcheting that made base reading practical. Branton's status and the Kasianowicz claim complicate a clean trio.
assessment.maturity: Technology is mature and widely used; accuracy has improved substantially, though competition with other sequencing methods continues.
uncertainties: Whether living versus deceased contributors constrain the configuration
Boundary between concept, pore engineering and enzyme-motor ratchet
Overlap with sequencing candidate B058

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA origami and programmable DNA nanostructures made molecular self-assembly into a design discipline, delivering nanometre-precise structures and dynamic devices; closely related to the molecular-machine theme and widely used in biophysics and nanotechnology.
assessment.attribution: Rothemund's 2006 scaffolded origami was the decisive demonstration; Winfree contributed algorithmic self-assembly and Yan the early DNA lattices and 3D structures. Nadrian Seeman, the founder of DNA nanotechnology, is not on the credited list, which makes a fair allocation hard to assess.
assessment.maturity: More than 15 years of confirmation and extensive adoption, but applications beyond research tools remain emerging.
uncertainties: Absence of Seeman from credited names raises an attribution problem
Practical impact is still mostly in research instrumentation
Overlap of Shih and Yin contributions

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Machine-learned interatomic potentials deliver near quantum accuracy at classical cost, opening length and time scales that were out of reach for simulating reactions and materials; a clear capability jump grounded in physical symmetry principles.
assessment.attribution: Behler and Parrinello's 2007 neural-network potentials started the field, Csanyi and Bartok introduced Gaussian approximation potentials; Weinan E and von Lilienfeld also contributed. Separating originators from rapidly proliferating refinements is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Rapid adoption, but the field is still evolving quickly and the dominant architectures are changing, so timing may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: Rapidly moving field with unsettled methods
Parrinello may be more naturally recognised with Car for first-principles dynamics (B039)
Recent AI prize recognition in 2024 may affect the committee's appetite

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Biomolecular phase separation reframed intracellular organisation using polymer-physics concepts, linking thermodynamics to cell biology and disease; a genuinely new principle with wide impact.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman's 2009 P-granule work launched the field, Rosen demonstrated multivalent phase separation in vitro, and Pappu and Mittag provided sequence-grammar physical chemistry. Whether this is chemistry or biology/physics is open.
assessment.maturity: Highly influential but still contested: the physiological relevance of many condensates and the mechanistic interpretation are debated, so maturity is limited.
uncertainties: Ongoing debate on the functional role of condensates in vivo
Fit with chemistry rather than medicine or physiology
Choice among five principal contributors

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation by PROTACs and molecular glues creates a new drug modality, converting binders into catalytic, event-driven degraders of previously undruggable proteins; strong chemical-biology and medicinal impact.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the first PROTACs; Ciulli advanced VHL-based degraders and structural rationale; Handa, Ito and others identified cereblon as the target of thalidomide-type glues, which is a separable and arguably equally decisive discovery.
assessment.maturity: Clinical trials are advanced but no PROTAC drug is yet approved, so the recognition may be early for the PROTAC part, while glue degraders have clinical precedent.
uncertainties: Compound discovery with PROTAC and glue-degrader parts needing different recognition
No approved PROTAC yet
Large credited list with disputed priority

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy landscape theory resolved Levinthal's paradox with a quantitative statistical-mechanical principle, the funnel, connecting folding, kinetics and function; the sort of clear underlying physical principle I value, with predictive links to experiment.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes, Onuchic and Dill contributed the funnel picture, minimal models and lattice-model physical insights; Bryngelson and Fersht (experimental mapping) are also credited, so the experimental versus theoretical weight is ambiguous.
assessment.maturity: Concept is mature and widely taught for decades, though much of recent protein structure progress came from AI methods, which may blur the novelty at this point.
uncertainties: 2024 prize on protein structure prediction may reduce appetite for another protein-folding recognition
Theory-heavy and less directly tied to a concrete tool
Distinguishing original theory from later refinement is nontrivial
